title: IVG Intense Salts Fresh Mint 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Fresh Mint provides a straightforward mint profile. The flavour is crisp and cooling, delivering a clean Mint taste that’s punchy without being overpowering. Balanced at 50VG/50PG, this Nic Salt delivers smooth flavour, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Fresh Mint is best paired with mouth-to-lung (MTL) devices such as pod kits, pens, and starter systems. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Fresh Mint is a simple, refreshing blend for those who prefer uncluttered mint flavours.
